test_fbgemm_gpu_compatibility: test if the current GPU supports FBGEMM blockwise FP8 matmul operations
run_fp8_block_quantized_matmul: run block-wise quantized FP8 matrix multiplication with activation and weight tensors
quantize_activation_to_fp8: quantize an activation tensor to FP8 format and return the quantized values with scales
dequantize_fp8_weight: dequantize a block-quantized or row-quantized FP8 weight tensor back to bfloat16
patch_fp8_linear_forward: patch FP8 linear layer forward methods to use optimized Unsloth FP8 kernels
